message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build wheels
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"
      - "[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-**"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install build tools
        run: |
          python -m pip install -U pip
          pip install setuptools build

      - name: Build sdist and wheel
        env:
          NO_SQLITE: 1
        run: |
          python -m build .

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: package
          path: dist/peewee*

  publish:
    needs: [build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: package
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          user: __token__
          password: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads/installs pip build tools (pip, setuptools, build) on every tag build. The repository has pyproject.toml, so dependency inputs are identifiable and cache-keyable. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) reports a measured VM-time benefit for caching dependency downloads, with preconditions met: repeated dependency fetching and cache inputs including the environment/manifest. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cache/pip keyed on hashFiles('pyproject.toml') before installing build tools preserves the full build and publish coverage, changes nothing about permissions, secrets, or publishing, and adds no new network access beyond the existing PyPI publish step.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
